note: What a server sends to add a quest to the quest tracker, complete it or remove it. The header carries zero.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A key into the client's own text for the quest. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: The quest's icon. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: tooltip
fields.note: A key into the client's own text, taken to be its tooltip; what the client does with it is not recorded. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which tracker it goes in. A tracker that is full holds a new quest back until it has room.

fields.name: action
fields.note: What to do. A client ignores any other value.

0.name: activate
0.note: Add the quest, with the three strings, kind, quest and first.

1.name: complete
1.note: Complete it, with quest, kind and first; the strings have no effect.

2.name: remove
2.note: Take it from the tracker, with quest and kind.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: first
bits.note: For activate, set to have the client report the pointer passing over the quest (QuestEvent); for complete, set where the quest succeeded.

fields.note: What a flag means depends on action.

fields.name: quest
fields.note: The quest's number, which QuestEvent returns.

fields.name: text
fields.note: A key into the client's own text for the quest. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: The quest's icon. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: tooltip
fields.note: A key into the client's own text for its tooltip. It applies to activate only.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which tracker it goes in. A tracker that is full holds a new quest back until it has room.

fields.name: action
fields.note: What to do. A client ignores any other value.

1.name: complete
1.note: Announce it done, or failed, for about four seconds, and take it from the tracker five seconds later.

2.name: remove
2.note: Take it from the tracker at once; a quest held back takes its place.
